name: Kobold Expert 2/Fighter 2
body:
Possible Error

The damage modifier on this Kobold (+8) seems to be higher than it should be, as using a two-handed weapon with a strength modifier of +2 and power attack with BAB +3 should result in a +6 modifier, not +8.

Kobold Expert 2/Fighter 2
	CR 3

XP 800

Male kobold expert 2/fighter 2

LE Small humanoid (reptilian)

Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)

hp 28 (2d6+4 and 2d10+4)

Fort +5, Ref +1, Will +4

Weakness light sensitivity

OFFENSE
Speed 30 ft.
Melee masterwork heavy pick +5 (1d4+8/x4)

Tactics
During Combat Lekmek wields his pick two handed using Power Attack (already figured in).
Morale Lekmek is too ornery to flee
STATISTICS
Str 15, Dex 12, Con 14, Int 9, Wis 12, Cha 14
Base Atk +3; CMB +4; CMD 15
Feats Improved Unarmed Strike, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Intimidate), Weapon Focus (heavy pick)
Skills Appraise +4, Acrobatics +6, Climb +5, Craft (trapmaking) +6, Escape Artist +5, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +3, Perception +7, Profession (miner) +7, Stealth +6
Languages Draconic
Gear masterwork heavy pick, masterwork studded leather, steel mining helmet
